outline.description: This chapter introduces the factual dispute, the legal claims brought by the plaintiff, and the procedural state of the case leading up to the Eighth Circuit's review.
subtopics: Factual background: Consilio's 2019 premium overtime policy change
The three statutory bases for the lawsuit: MPWA, MFLSA, and MWTA
The partial settlement: Payment of overtime wages and liquidated damages
The remaining dispute: Entitlement to statutory penalties
The district court's grant of summary judgment and the standard of review (de novo)

outline.description: This chapter examines the court's analysis of whether an employee has a private right to seek penalties under the Minnesota Payment of Wages Act.
subtopics: Analysis of Minn. Stat. Ann. § 181.101 and § 181.171
The distinction between 'prosecuting a claim for wages' and collecting civil penalties
The role of the Commissioner in triggering and collecting penalties
The 'plain and unambiguous' rule of statutory interpretation
Comparative statutory analysis: How the legislature empowers employees in other sections (e.g., § 181.13)

outline.chapter_title: Jurisdiction and Mootness under the MFLSA
outline.description: This chapter explores the complex jurisdictional issues regarding civil penalties that are payable to the government rather than the plaintiff.
subtopics: The nature of civil penalties and the 'redress' provided to citizen plaintiffs
Standing requirements: The necessity of a continuing personal interest
Mootness vs. Voluntary Cessation: When a defendant's stop of a practice does not strip the court of jurisdiction
The distinction between payment of back-wages and the persistence of a violative policy
The court's decision to vacate and remand for a jurisdictional determination

outline.chapter_title: The MWTA Claim and Requests for Injunctive Relief
outline.description: This chapter addresses the remaining claims, focusing on the failure to provide legal authority for penalties and the procedural errors regarding the request for injunctive relief.
subtopics: The MWTA claim: Lack of statutory authority for civil penalties
The legal consequence of failing to provide supporting argument in a brief (waiver)
Procedural requirements for amending requests for relief (FRCP 15)
Why the request to rescind the overtime policy was not properly before the court
